Prvi tajvanski ARC: rok, potrebni dokumenti i takse
Rok za prvi ARC računa se od narednog dana po ulasku sa boravišnom vizom i odobrenjem boravka, ili od izdavanja te vize na Tajvanu. Dokazi i postupak zavise od osnova boravka.
Jednobojna putna knjižica, fascikla sa dokumentima i mala prazna kartica na stolu
Izmišljeni prizor
Od kog dana računam rok za prvi ARC?

Posle ulaska sa boravišnom vizom i odobrenjem boravka, zahtev se podnosi u roku od 30 dana od narednog dana po ulasku. Ako je boravišna viza izdata tek na Tajvanu, BOCA računa 30 dana od njenog izdavanja. Neposredna prijava nakon ulaska bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu zavisi od uslova i rokova konkretne kategorije.
Kolika je taksa za prvi ARC?

Osnovna taksa iznosi 1.000 novih tajvanskih dolara za svaku odobrenu godinu; period kraći od godine naplaćuje se kao cela godina. U odgovarajućim postupcima posle ulaska bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu dodaje se 2.200 dolara. Propisi predviđaju određena umanjenja i oslobođenja.
Da li smem da radim čim dobijem ARC?
Rad je moguć samo ako stvarni posao i poslodavca obuhvata važeća dozvola ili primenljivo zakonsko oslobođenje. ARC potvrđuje odobren boravak, ali sam ne daje neograničeno pravo na rad.

sourcePassages.text: Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. Immigration Act Article 22 requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in Article 22.
Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.
Entry and visa status
When to apply
Entered with a resident visa
Within 30 days counted from the day after entry.
Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan
Within 30 days from the resident visa's issuance date, under BOCA's guidance.
Entered visa-exempt or with a visitor visa
Before the permitted stay expires, subject to the eligibility and filing rules for the residence category.

NIA's residence guide and BOCA's resident-visa guidance explain the first two situations. For eligible professionals, Article 16 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals permits a direct NIA residence application after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry, with work authorization or an applicable exemption. Eligibility is specific to that route; the work, study and family comparison explains the conditions for other applicants.

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to NIA's checklist. Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.
The supporting evidence depends on why you are staying:
Employment: the relevant work approval and a certificate of employment issued within the preceding month, or evidence of the applicable exemption.
Degree study: an admission letter before registration, or recent enrollment evidence once registered.
Family residence: marriage or birth records proving the relationship, together with the sponsoring family member's identity or residence documents.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the NIA guide; the Taiwan-spouse residence article covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

NIA's residence application directory separates general residence applications from those for professionals and their dependents, students, and migrant workers. Each category has a designated online system or service-center procedure. Using the professional-worker system is appropriate only if your employment category belongs there.

Students use a dedicated online procedure. For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its residence guide.
Keep the submission record and uploaded documents. If NIA requests further evidence, retaining the request with the original file makes it clear which documents still need to be supplied.

Standard ARC fees are NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity, with a period under one year charged as a full year. Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards adds NT$2,200 for applications following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. Its reduction for overseas compatriot students applies to that status, not to international students generally.

NIA decides the approved term. The ordinary statutory maximum is three years, while qualifying specialist professionals have a separate maximum under their legislation (Immigration Act Article 22; Foreign Professionals Act Article 8). Paying a higher fee cannot establish eligibility for a longer period.

For general applications, NIA gives a processing time of ten working days, excluding document return, requests for additional documents and interviews. The processing period starts again after the additional documents are submitted. Online categories have their own schedules, which may affect travel plans while the application is pending.

Under the student online procedure, payment is due within five working days from approval. A student collecting a smart-chip ARC must print the online payment receipt and take it to the selected NIA service center three working days after payment. That timetable applies to this student procedure; other applicants should follow the method and identification requirements in their approval or collection notice.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48. Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the renewal and changes guide.

targetPassages.text: Boravišna viza izdata tek posle dolaska na Tajvan pokreće rok za prvi ARC od datuma svog izdavanja, prema uputstvu Biroa za konzularne poslove, BOCA. Rok je 30 dana.

Za osobu koja je ušla sa boravišnom vizom i dobila odobrenje boravka, član 22 Zakona o ulasku, izlasku i imigraciji nalaže prijavu u roku od 30 dana od narednog dana po ulasku. Zahtev prima Nacionalna imigraciona agencija, NIA. Ona izdaje Alien Resident Certificate, odnosno ARC, kao potvrdu odobrenog boravka.

Važeći Employment Gold Card ili drugi objedinjeni dokument sa funkcijom ARC-a obuhvaćen je zakonskim izuzetkom od posebne prijave. Posetiocu bez boravišne vize najpre je potreban odgovarajući osnov za prelazak na boravak; sam dolazak ne otvara opšti rok za takvu promenu.
Način ulaska ili izdavanja vize
Podnošenje zahteva
Ulazak sa boravišnom vizom i odobrenjem boravka
U roku od 30 dana od narednog dana po ulasku.
Boravišna viza izdata na Tajvanu posle dolaska
U roku od 30 dana od datuma izdavanja vize.
Ulazak bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu
Pre isteka dopuštenog kratkotrajnog boravka, uz uslove i rokove propisane za konkretnu kategoriju.

BOCA objašnjava postupak za zaposlene u uputstvu o boravišnim vizama za stručni rad. Za stranog stručnjaka ili stručnjaka sa posebnim kvalifikacijama, koji ima dozvolu za stručni rad ili odgovarajuće oslobođenje, član 16 Zakona o privlačenju i zapošljavanju stranih stručnjaka predviđa i neposredan zahtev NIA-i nakon odgovarajućeg ulaska bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu. Tek odobrenje boravka vodi izdavanju ARC-a. Uslove za druge podnosioce razdvaja tekst o radu, studijama i porodici.

Za prijavu na osnovu boravišne vize NIA 0902 traži obrazac, fotografiju iz poslednje dve godine, pasoš i boravišnu vizu, dokaz razloga boravka i dokaz stvarne adrese. Potrebni su originali i kopije prema spisku. Originali se vraćaju posle provere. Ugovor o zakupu može poslužiti kao dokaz adrese.
Fotografija za vizu može imati drugačiji zahtev: BOCA za studentsku vizu traži fotografiju iz poslednjih šest meseci. Zato dokumentacija za ARC i raniju vizu ne mora imati isti vremenski obuhvat.
Osnov prijave
Dokazi prema kategoriji
Stručni rad
Odgovarajuće odobrenje za rad i potvrda o zaposlenju izdata u poslednjih mesec dana; za oslobođenje od dozvole, dokaz primenljivog oslobođenja.
Studije
Pismo o prijemu pre upisa; posle upisa, potvrda o studiranju izdata u poslednjih mesec dana, prema spisku NIA.
Spajanje porodice
Izvod o braku ili rođenju kojim se dokazuje odnos, uz identifikacione ili boravišne dokumente člana porodice na kojem se zahtev zasniva.

Kod prve prijave po osnovu braka sa državljaninom Tajvana koji tamo živi i ima registraciju domaćinstva, tajvanski supružnik mora doći sa podnosiocem. Potreban je i dokaz da je brak registrovan na Tajvanu. Član 12 propisa o boravku stranaca ograničava taj prvi ARC na najviše godinu dana, a NIA uputstvo uređuje prisustvo supružnika. Taj maksimum ne važi za svaku porodičnu kategoriju. Više dokumenata opisuje tekst o boravku preko tajvanskog supružnika, na engleskom.

Isprave izdate u inostranstvu moraju proći propisanu autentifikaciju. NIA može zahtevati i prevod na kineski potvrđen ili overen na propisani način. Postupak se proverava kod tajvanskog predstavništva nadležnog za mesto izdavanja; ne treba unapred pretpostaviti da određena strana overa zamenjuje taj postupak. Uverenje o nekažnjavanju i zdravstveni pregled zavise od kategorije i primenljivih izuzetaka. Nisu opšti uslov svake prve kartice.

Imenik boravišnih postupaka NIA odvaja opšte prijave, stručnjake i njihovu porodicu, studente i radnike u drugim migracionim kategorijama. Svaki postupak ima određeni portal ili službu. Samo zaposlenje na Tajvanu ne potvrđuje pristup sistemu za stručnjake.

Studenti koriste poseban onlajn postupak 0929. Za redovan lični zahtev nadležna je služba NIA prema sadašnjoj adresi; tu se podnose i prijave preko tajvanskog supružnika. Sačuvajte broj predmeta i dokumente koje ste poslali.

Poziv za dopunu treba čuvati uz prvobitnu prijavu. Prema kineskom tekstu NIA 0902, redovni rok za dopunu iznosi 15 kalendarskih dana od narednog dana po obaveštenju. Ako nedostajuću ili neodgovarajuću ispravu treba pribaviti u inostranstvu, kontinentalnoj Kini, Hongkongu ili Makau, rok je tri meseca. Neblagovremena ili nepotpuna dopuna vodi odbijanju zahteva. To nije produženje boravka.

Osnovna taksa je 1.000 novih tajvanskih dolara za svaku odobrenu godinu važenja. Kraći period naplaćuje se kao cela godina. Član 3 pravila o imigracionim taksama predviđa još 2.200 dolara za odgovarajuće prijave nakon ulaska bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu. Studenti sa priznatim statusom 僑生 imaju umanjenje relevantnih ARC taksi od 50%; ono ne obuhvata sve strane studente.

Trajanje određuje NIA. Opšti zakonski maksimum je tri godine, prema članu 22. Za zaposlenog stranog stručnjaka sa posebnim kvalifikacijama kome je NIA odobrila boravak, član 8 Zakona o stranim stručnjacima predviđa najviše pet godina, računajući od narednog dana po tom odobrenju. Isto pravilo obuhvata propisane članove porodice kojima je odobren boravak. Veća uplata ne obezbeđuje duže odobrenje.
NIA za opšti postupak navodi deset radnih dana. Vreme vraćanja dokumentacije, dopune i razgovora ne ulazi u taj period. Posle dopune računanje počinje iznova.
Studentski onlajn postupak ima svoje rokove. U uputstvu 0929 navedeno je pet radnih dana za proveru, koji se ponovo računaju posle dopune. Taksu treba platiti u roku od pet radnih dana od odobrenja.

Elektronski ARC sa važenjem do šest meseci mora se preuzeti i odštampati nakon uplate. Za karticu sa čipom student štampa onlajn potvrdu uplate i odnosi je u izabranu službu NIA tri radna dana posle izvršene uplate. Ovaj raspored pripada studentskom postupku; ostali podnosioci prate način preuzimanja iz svog odobrenja ili obaveštenja.
Na izdatoj kartici uporedite ime, broj pasoša, adresu i datum isteka sa odobrenim podacima. Odluku i potvrdu uplate čuvajte u istom dosijeu.

Može li posao početi čim kartica stigne? Članovi 43 i 48 Zakona o službama zapošljavanja zahtevaju da stvarni posao i poslodavca pokriva odgovarajuća dozvola ili oslobođenje. Sledeći rokovi proizlaze iz isteka boravka, selidbe, promene rada i planiranog povratka sa puta. Njih razrađuje vodič za produženje i promene ARC-a, uz dokumente koji pokazuju kada je promena nastala.

Izvori su provereni 24. oktobra 2026, uz dopunsku proveru navedenih pravila 25. oktobra. Tekst opisuje postupke za strane državljane, bez odluke o pojedinačnoj podobnosti. Za stanovnike kontinentalne Kine, Hongkonga i Makaa i državljane Republike Kine bez registracije domaćinstva važe posebni sistemi.

Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. [Immigration Act Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22) requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in [Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22).

## Which date starts the application period?

Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.

| Entry and visa status | When to apply |
|---|---|
| Entered with a resident visa | Within 30 days counted from the day after entry. |
| Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan | Within 30 days from the resident visa's issuance date, under BOCA's guidance. |
| Entered visa-exempt or with a visitor visa | Before the permitted stay expires, subject to the eligibility and filing rules for the residence category. |

[NIA's residence guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) and [BOCA's resident-visa guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html) explain the first two situations. For eligible professionals, [Article 16 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) permits a direct NIA residence application after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry, with work authorization or an applicable exemption. Eligibility is specific to that route; the [work, study and family comparison](/en/columns/taiwan-visa-residence-work-study-family) explains the conditions for other applicants.

## Documents that establish your residence basis

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to [NIA's checklist](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970). Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.

The supporting evidence depends on why you are staying:

- Employment: the relevant work approval and a certificate of employment issued within the preceding month, or evidence of the applicable exemption.
- Degree study: an admission letter before registration, or recent enrollment evidence once registered.
- Family residence: marriage or birth records proving the relationship, together with the sponsoring family member's identity or residence documents.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the [NIA guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970); the [Taiwan-spouse residence article](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence) covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The [Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

## Where the application goes

NIA's [residence application directory](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/) separates general residence applications from those for professionals and their dependents, students, and migrant workers. Each category has a designated online system or service-center procedure. Using the professional-worker system is appropriate only if your employment category belongs there.

Students use a [dedicated online procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news). For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its [residence guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970).

Keep the submission record and uploaded documents. If NIA requests further evidence, retaining the request with the original file makes it clear which documents still need to be supplied.

## Fees, processing and collection

Standard ARC fees are NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity, with a period under one year charged as a full year. [Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) adds NT$2,200 for applications following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. Its reduction for overseas compatriot students applies to that status, not to international students generally.

NIA decides the approved term. The ordinary statutory maximum is three years, while qualifying specialist professionals have a separate maximum under their legislation ([Immigration Act Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22); [Foreign Professionals Act Article 8](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295)). Paying a higher fee cannot establish eligibility for a longer period.

For general applications, [NIA gives a processing time of ten working days](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), excluding document return, requests for additional documents and interviews. The processing period starts again after the additional documents are submitted. Online categories have their own schedules, which may affect travel plans while the application is pending.

Under the [student online procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), payment is due within five working days from approval. A student collecting a smart-chip ARC must print the online payment receipt and take it to the selected NIA service center three working days after payment. That timetable applies to this student procedure; other applicants should follow the method and identification requirements in their approval or collection notice.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under [Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001). Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the [renewal and changes guide](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry).

Sources checked October 24, 2026. This procedural guide concerns foreign nationals and does not determine individual eligibility. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

## Official sources

- [Immigration Act, Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22): first-card deadline, integrated-document exception and ordinary validity limit.
- [NIA, residence, extension and change applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), updated April 14, 2026: documents, fees, processing and spouse attendance.
- [BOCA, resident visas for professional employees](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html): ARC timing following resident visa issuance in Taiwan.
- [Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), Articles 8 and 16: specialist validity and direct residence applications.
- [NIA, residence application directory](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/): category-specific application channels.
- [NIA, student online applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), updated August 28, 2026: student filing, payment and collection.
- [Taiwan overseas mission directory](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html): document authentication inquiries.
- [Immigration permit fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135), Article 3: ARC fees and specified reductions.
- [Employment Service Act](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), Articles 43 and 48: work authorization and exemptions.

Boravišna viza izdata tek posle dolaska na Tajvan pokreće rok za prvi ARC od datuma svog izdavanja, prema [uputstvu Biroa za konzularne poslove, BOCA](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-398-723-7b71f-1.html). Rok je 30 dana.

Za osobu koja je ušla sa boravišnom vizom i dobila odobrenje boravka, [član 22 Zakona o ulasku, izlasku i imigraciji](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22) nalaže prijavu u roku od 30 dana od narednog dana po ulasku. Zahtev prima Nacionalna imigraciona agencija, NIA. Ona izdaje Alien Resident Certificate, odnosno ARC, kao potvrdu odobrenog boravka.

Važeći Employment Gold Card ili drugi objedinjeni dokument sa funkcijom ARC-a obuhvaćen je zakonskim izuzetkom od posebne prijave. Posetiocu bez boravišne vize najpre je potreban odgovarajući osnov za prelazak na boravak; sam dolazak ne otvara opšti rok za takvu promenu.

## Viza određuje početak roka

| Način ulaska ili izdavanja vize | Podnošenje zahteva |
|---|---|
| Ulazak sa boravišnom vizom i odobrenjem boravka | U roku od 30 dana od narednog dana po ulasku. |
| Boravišna viza izdata na Tajvanu posle dolaska | U roku od 30 dana od datuma izdavanja vize. |
| Ulazak bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu | Pre isteka dopuštenog kratkotrajnog boravka, uz uslove i rokove propisane za konkretnu kategoriju. |

BOCA objašnjava postupak za zaposlene u [uputstvu o boravišnim vizama za stručni rad](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html). Za stranog stručnjaka ili stručnjaka sa posebnim kvalifikacijama, koji ima dozvolu za stručni rad ili odgovarajuće oslobođenje, [član 16 Zakona o privlačenju i zapošljavanju stranih stručnjaka](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) predviđa i neposredan zahtev NIA-i nakon odgovarajućeg ulaska bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu. Tek odobrenje boravka vodi izdavanju ARC-a. Uslove za druge podnosioce razdvaja tekst o [radu, studijama i porodici](/sr/columns/taiwan-visa-residence-work-study-family).

## Dokument kojim se dokazuje razlog boravka

Za prijavu na osnovu boravišne vize [NIA 0902](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) traži obrazac, fotografiju iz poslednje dve godine, pasoš i boravišnu vizu, dokaz razloga boravka i dokaz stvarne adrese. Potrebni su originali i kopije prema spisku. Originali se vraćaju posle provere. Ugovor o zakupu može poslužiti kao dokaz adrese.

Fotografija za vizu može imati drugačiji zahtev: [BOCA za studentsku vizu](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) traži fotografiju iz poslednjih šest meseci. Zato dokumentacija za ARC i raniju vizu ne mora imati isti vremenski obuhvat.

| Osnov prijave | Dokazi prema kategoriji |
|---|---|
| Stručni rad | Odgovarajuće odobrenje za rad i potvrda o zaposlenju izdata u poslednjih mesec dana; za oslobođenje od dozvole, dokaz primenljivog oslobođenja. |
| Studije | Pismo o prijemu pre upisa; posle upisa, potvrda o studiranju izdata u poslednjih mesec dana, prema spisku NIA. |
| Spajanje porodice | Izvod o braku ili rođenju kojim se dokazuje odnos, uz identifikacione ili boravišne dokumente člana porodice na kojem se zahtev zasniva. |

Kod prve prijave po osnovu braka sa državljaninom Tajvana koji tamo živi i ima registraciju domaćinstva, tajvanski supružnik mora doći sa podnosiocem. Potreban je i dokaz da je brak registrovan na Tajvanu. [Član 12 propisa o boravku stranaca](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129) ograničava taj prvi ARC na najviše godinu dana, a [NIA uputstvo](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) uređuje prisustvo supružnika. Taj maksimum ne važi za svaku porodičnu kategoriju. Više dokumenata opisuje [tekst o boravku preko tajvanskog supružnika, na engleskom](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence).

Isprave izdate u inostranstvu moraju proći propisanu autentifikaciju. NIA može zahtevati i prevod na kineski potvrđen ili overen na propisani način. Postupak se proverava kod [tajvanskog predstavništva nadležnog za mesto izdavanja](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html); ne treba unapred pretpostaviti da određena strana overa zamenjuje taj postupak. Uverenje o nekažnjavanju i zdravstveni pregled zavise od kategorije i primenljivih izuzetaka. Nisu opšti uslov svake prve kartice.

## Nadležni sistem i dopuna spisa

[Imenik boravišnih postupaka NIA](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/) odvaja opšte prijave, stručnjake i njihovu porodicu, studente i radnike u drugim migracionim kategorijama. Svaki postupak ima određeni portal ili službu. Samo zaposlenje na Tajvanu ne potvrđuje pristup sistemu za stručnjake.

Studenti koriste [poseban onlajn postupak 0929](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news). Za redovan lični zahtev nadležna je služba NIA prema sadašnjoj adresi; tu se podnose i prijave preko tajvanskog supružnika. Sačuvajte broj predmeta i dokumente koje ste poslali.

Poziv za dopunu treba čuvati uz prvobitnu prijavu. Prema [kineskom tekstu NIA 0902](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/29996/), redovni rok za dopunu iznosi 15 kalendarskih dana od narednog dana po obaveštenju. Ako nedostajuću ili neodgovarajuću ispravu treba pribaviti u inostranstvu, kontinentalnoj Kini, Hongkongu ili Makau, rok je tri meseca. Neblagovremena ili nepotpuna dopuna vodi odbijanju zahteva. To nije produženje boravka.

## Taksa i odobreni period

Osnovna taksa je 1.000 novih tajvanskih dolara za svaku odobrenu godinu važenja. Kraći period naplaćuje se kao cela godina. [Član 3 pravila o imigracionim taksama](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) predviđa još 2.200 dolara za odgovarajuće prijave nakon ulaska bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu. Studenti sa priznatim statusom 僑生 imaju umanjenje relevantnih ARC taksi od 50%; ono ne obuhvata sve strane studente.

Trajanje određuje NIA. Opšti zakonski maksimum je tri godine, prema [članu 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22). Za zaposlenog stranog stručnjaka sa posebnim kvalifikacijama kome je NIA odobrila boravak, [član 8 Zakona o stranim stručnjacima](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) predviđa najviše pet godina, računajući od narednog dana po tom odobrenju. Isto pravilo obuhvata propisane članove porodice kojima je odobren boravak. Veća uplata ne obezbeđuje duže odobrenje.

## Od provere prijave do kartice

[NIA za opšti postupak navodi deset radnih dana](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970). Vreme vraćanja dokumentacije, dopune i razgovora ne ulazi u taj period. Posle dopune računanje počinje iznova.

Studentski onlajn postupak ima svoje rokove. U [uputstvu 0929](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news) navedeno je pet radnih dana za proveru, koji se ponovo računaju posle dopune. Taksu treba platiti u roku od pet radnih dana od odobrenja.

Elektronski ARC sa važenjem do šest meseci mora se preuzeti i odštampati nakon uplate. Za karticu sa čipom student štampa onlajn potvrdu uplate i odnosi je u izabranu službu NIA tri radna dana posle izvršene uplate. Ovaj raspored pripada studentskom postupku; ostali podnosioci prate način preuzimanja iz svog odobrenja ili obaveštenja.

Na izdatoj kartici uporedite ime, broj pasoša, adresu i datum isteka sa odobrenim podacima. Odluku i potvrdu uplate čuvajte u istom dosijeu.

Može li posao početi čim kartica stigne? [Članovi 43 i 48 Zakona o službama zapošljavanja](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) zahtevaju da stvarni posao i poslodavca pokriva odgovarajuća dozvola ili oslobođenje. Sledeći rokovi proizlaze iz isteka boravka, selidbe, promene rada i planiranog povratka sa puta. Njih razrađuje [vodič za produženje i promene ARC-a](/sr/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry), uz dokumente koji pokazuju kada je promena nastala.

Izvori su provereni 24. oktobra 2026, uz dopunsku proveru navedenih pravila 25. oktobra. Tekst opisuje postupke za strane državljane, bez odluke o pojedinačnoj podobnosti. Za stanovnike kontinentalne Kine, Hongkonga i Makaa i državljane Republike Kine bez registracije domaćinstva važe posebni sistemi.

## Zvanični izvori

- [Zakon o ulasku, izlasku i imigraciji, član 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22): rok, objedinjeni dokument i opšti maksimum.
- [NIA 0902, prijave boravka i promena](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), ažurirano 14. aprila 2026; [kineski tekst](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/29996/): početak roka za dopunu i posledice nepotpune dopune.
- BOCA: [rok nakon izdavanja boravišne vize na Tajvanu](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-398-723-7b71f-1.html) i [vize za stručni rad](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html).
- [Zakon o privlačenju i zapošljavanju stranih stručnjaka](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), članovi 8 i 16.
- [Propisi o kratkotrajnim posetama, boravku i stalnom boravku stranaca](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129), član 12: prvi ARC supružnika tajvanskog državljanina.
- NIA: [imenik postupaka](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/) i [studentski onlajn postupak 0929](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), ažuriran 28. avgusta 2026.
- BOCA: [studentske vize](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) i [imenik predstavništava](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html).
- [Pravila o taksama za imigracione dozvole](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135), član 3.
- [Zakon o službama zapošljavanja](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), članovi 43 i 48.

sourceHints.text: Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. Immigration Act Article 22 requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.
Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.
Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to NIA's checklist. Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the NIA guide; the Taiwan-spouse residence article covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

Students use a dedicated online procedure. For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its residence guide.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

sourcePassages.text: Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. Foreign Professionals Act Article 16 permits the professional route; BOCA's degree-study and Mandarin-study guidance set different entry conditions for students.
Nationality and the passport used determine visa eligibility. The Taiwan overseas mission handling your application provides the nationality-specific requirements and document procedures.

A temporary visitor's permitted activities and length of stay depend on the entry arrangement granted. A longer move requires a residence basis, such as employment, study or joining family. BOCA's resident-visa guidance covers those purposes, while the National Immigration Agency (NIA) decides residence applications and issues the Alien Resident Certificate (ARC).
Some eligible visitors can apply directly to NIA. Other applicants need the appropriate visa before entry, so arriving as a visitor leaves no general right to convert a short stay into residence.

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's legislative history.

NIA's guide excludes trial visa exemptions, the Southeast Asian online travel-authorization scheme and other listed entry arrangements from this direct-application route unless another rule applies, even where the applicant holds work approval.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under Employment Service Act Article 46 have their own rules. NIA's migrant-worker residence procedure applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

Full-time foreign students applying from abroad can seek a resident visa at a Taiwan overseas mission. Those who enter on a visitor visa specifically for foreign-student study may apply directly to NIA for residence. The ordinary in-country study route in BOCA's student guidance excludes visa-exempt entry, landing visas and visitor visas issued for other purposes.

Depending on the application, BOCA also requires educational records, financial evidence and a health certificate alongside the admission letter; the program's checklist determines which overseas records need authentication.

For Mandarin learners, the language-study visitor visa ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50 govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under Immigration Act Article 23 requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in residence through a Taiwan spouse.

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, Article 16 allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. Employment Service Act Article 48 provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. For qualifying spouses of specialist or senior professionals, Foreign Professionals Act Article 15 provides a direct application for a work permit.

Specialist professionals who meet the program's criteria may qualify for an Employment Gold Card, which combines work, residence, visa and re-entry functions in one document. The Gold Card article covers that application separately.
BOCA publishes the entrepreneur route requirements for applicants planning to establish a business in Taiwan.

Working-holiday access depends on the nationality-specific program. The digital-nomad visitor visa has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. Foreign Professionals Act Article 14 limits that remote-work route to qualifying work without providing services to Taiwan businesses or employers.

Once the residence category and entry requirements are established, the first ARC application guide covers filing and collection. An existing resident moving to a new job, course or family basis also needs the rules on renewal and changes: the current card does not settle whether that new purpose qualifies.

Jedan postupak iz člana 23 Zakona o ulasku, izlasku i imigraciji obuhvata supružnika državljanina Tajvana koji živi na Tajvanu i ima registraciju domaćinstva. Za supružnika stranog stručnjaka sa posebnim kvalifikacijama ili visokokvalifikovanog stranog stručnjaka postoji član 15 Zakona o stranim stručnjacima. Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. [Foreign Professionals Act Article 16](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) permits the professional route; BOCA's [degree-study](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) and [Mandarin-study guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) set different entry conditions for students.

Nationality and the passport used determine visa eligibility. The [Taiwan overseas mission handling your application](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) provides the nationality-specific requirements and document procedures.

## Permission for a visit and permission to reside

A temporary visitor's permitted activities and length of stay depend on the entry arrangement granted. A longer move requires a residence basis, such as employment, study or joining family. BOCA's [resident-visa guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-165-1878-1ff5e-2.html) covers those purposes, while the National Immigration Agency (NIA) decides residence applications and issues the Alien Resident Certificate (ARC).

Some eligible visitors can apply directly to NIA. Other applicants need the appropriate visa before entry, so arriving as a visitor leaves no general right to convert a short stay into residence.

## An employment offer is the start of the application

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. [Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's [legislative history](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawHistory.aspx?pcode=A0030295).

[NIA's guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141824/cp_news) excludes trial visa exemptions, the Southeast Asian online travel-authorization scheme and other listed entry arrangements from this direct-application route unless another rule applies, even where the applicant holds work approval.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under [Employment Service Act Article 46](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) have their own rules. NIA's [migrant-worker residence procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/181964/) applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

## Degree students and Mandarin learners

Full-time foreign students applying from abroad can seek a resident visa at a Taiwan overseas mission. Those who enter on a visitor visa specifically for foreign-student study may apply directly to NIA for residence. The ordinary in-country study route in [BOCA's student guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) excludes visa-exempt entry, landing visas and visitor visas issued for other purposes.

Depending on the application, BOCA also requires educational records, financial evidence and a health certificate alongside the admission letter; the program's checklist determines which overseas records need authentication.

For Mandarin learners, the [language-study visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. [BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-166-285-041cb-2.html) requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? [Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

## Joining a spouse or parent in Taiwan

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under [Immigration Act Article 23](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23) requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in [residence through a Taiwan spouse](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence).

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, [Article 16](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. [Employment Service Act Article 48](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. For qualifying spouses of specialist or senior professionals, [Foreign Professionals Act Article 15](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) provides a direct application for a work permit.

## Gold Cards, founders and longer visits

Specialist professionals who meet the program's criteria may qualify for an [Employment Gold Card](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/), which combines work, residence, visa and re-entry functions in one document. The [Gold Card article](/en/columns/taiwan-employment-gold-card) covers that application separately.

BOCA publishes the [entrepreneur route requirements](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html) for applicants planning to establish a business in Taiwan.

Working-holiday access depends on the [nationality-specific program](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html). The [digital-nomad visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html) has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. [Foreign Professionals Act Article 14](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) limits that remote-work route to qualifying work without providing services to Taiwan businesses or employers.

Once the residence category and entry requirements are established, the [first ARC application guide](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application) covers filing and collection. An existing resident moving to a new job, course or family basis also needs the [rules on renewal and changes](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry): the current card does not settle whether that new purpose qualifies.

Sources checked October 24, 2026. Eligibility still depends on the individual application. These routes concern foreign nationals; Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

- [Immigration Act, Article 23](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23): qualifying in-country residence routes.
- [Employment Service Act](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), Articles 43, 46, 48 and 50: work categories, permits, exemptions and student work.
- BOCA: [resident visas](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-165-1878-1ff5e-2.html), [foreign students](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html), [Mandarin visitor visas](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html), [Mandarin residence](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-166-285-041cb-2.html).
- [NIA, residence applications after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141824/cp_news), note 7(1), updated April 14, 2026: excluded entry arrangements and exceptions under other applicable rules.
- [NIA, migrant-worker residence applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/181964/).
- Official [Employment Gold Card information](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/) and [BOCA entrepreneur materials](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html).
- BOCA, [working-holiday programs](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html) and [digital-nomad visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html).
- [Taiwan overseas mission directory](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html): relevant consular offices.

Dokazi odnosa opisani su u [tekstu o tajvanskom supružniku, na engleskom](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence).

Porodična prijava iz [člana 16 stav 2 Zakona o stranim stručnjacima](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) može se zasnivati na statusu stranog stručnjaka koji obavlja stručni posao na Tajvanu ili stranog stručnjaka sa posebnim kvalifikacijama. U oba slučaja NIA tom licu već mora da je odobrila boravak ili stalni boravak.

Obuhvaćeni su supružnik, maloletna deca i punoletna deca koja zbog fizičkog ili mentalnog invaliditeta ne mogu samostalno da se staraju o sebi. Posle odgovarajućeg ulaska bez vize ili sa vizom za posetu mogu neposredno da zatraže boravak. Roditelji i druga punoletna deca nisu obuhvaćeni ovom odredbom. Za druge porodične kategorije ostaju njihovi uslovi i zakonska isključenja.

## Rad supružnika zavisi od porodične kategorije

[Član 48 Zakona o službama zapošljavanja](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) oslobađa od radne dozvole stranca kome je odobren boravak i koji je u braku sa tajvanskim državljaninom sa registracijom domaćinstva. Supružnik stranog stručnjaka ne dobija isto oslobođenje samo na osnovu porodičnog ARC-a.

Za supružnika stranog stručnjaka sa posebnim kvalifikacijama ili visokokvalifikovanog stranog stručnjaka postoji [član 15 Zakona o stranim stručnjacima](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295). Kada NIA tom supružniku odobri boravak radi spajanja porodice, on može sam da zatraži radnu dozvolu od Ministarstva rada. Rok te dozvole ne može preći period odobrenog porodičnog boravka.

## Gold Card, preduzetništvo i duže posete

[Employment Gold Card](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/) objedinjuje radnu dozvolu, boravišnu vizu, ARC i dozvolu ponovnog ulaska. Kandidat koji ispunjava kriterijume može se prijaviti bez unapred ugovorenog posla kod određenog poslodavca. Po članu 9 važenje je od jedne do tri godine. Detalji su u [vodiču za Gold Card na engleskom](/en/columns/taiwan-employment-gold-card).

Osnivanje posla ima [poseban preduzetnički postupak BOCA](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html). Radni odmor zavisi od [programa za konkretno državljanstvo](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html). Ni [viza za posetu digitalnih nomada](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html) ne donosi ARC automatski: ima sopstvene uslove državljanstva i kvalifikacija. Kod rada na daljinu iz člana 14 ovog zakona nisu dopuštene usluge tajvanskim privrednim subjektima ili poslodavcima u okviru tog režima.

Po utvrđivanju osnova boravka, [prvi zahtev za ARC](/sr/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application) povezuje rok, dokumente i preuzimanje. Postojećem stanovniku koji menja posao, studije ili porodični osnov potreban je i [postupak promene ili produženja](/sr/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry). Njegov dosije treba da pokaže upravo novu svrhu boravka, a ne samo preostalo važenje stare kartice.

Izvori su provereni 24. oktobra 2026, uz dopunsku proveru navedenih pravila 25. oktobra. Ishod zavisi od uslova pojedinačne prijave. Ovi putevi odnose se na strane državljane; stanovnici kontinentalne Kine, Hongkonga i Makaa i državljani Republike Kine bez registracije domaćinstva podležu posebnim sistemima.

sourceEvidence.text: Article 16 of the Foreign Professionals Act allows qualifying professionals with work authorization or an exemption, and certain family members, to apply directly to NIA. Eligibility also depends on the entry arrangement used. Ordinary degree-study and Mandarin-study routes have different entry requirements.

Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. Foreign Professionals Act Article 16 permits the professional route; BOCA's degree-study and Mandarin-study guidance set different entry conditions for students.

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's legislative history.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under Employment Service Act Article 46 have their own rules. NIA's migrant-worker residence procedure applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

For Mandarin learners, the language-study visitor visa ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50 govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under Immigration Act Article 23 requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in residence through a Taiwan spouse.

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, Article 16 allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. Employment Service Act Article 48 provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. For qualifying spouses of specialist or senior professionals, Foreign Professionals Act Article 15 provides a direct application for a work permit.

Working-holiday access depends on the nationality-specific program. The digital-nomad visitor visa has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. source.title: When Your Taiwan ARC Needs Updating: Renewal, Moves and Travel
source.seoTitle: Taiwan ARC Renewal, Changes and Re-entry
source.summary: An ARC's expiry is only one deadline. Moving, changing jobs or losing your residence basis can trigger earlier filings; travel needs re-entry permission.

faq.q: How early can I renew my ARC?
faq.a: The general extension window opens three months before authorized residence expires. Gold Card renewal and qualifying entrepreneur ARC extensions for a continuing Taiwan business have separate four-month windows. These are advance filing periods, not grace periods after expiry.

faq.q: When must I report a move or a change in workplace?
faq.a: NIA registration is due within 30 days counted from the day after the change. A new employer may also require work authorization, and a change in the basis for residence may require a separate application. Updating the address or workplace record does not complete those procedures.

faq.q: Can I return to Taiwan with an ARC renewal receipt?
faq.a: A receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents. Before departure, ask NIA what document covers your return if the renewed card is still pending. Your passport, residence status and re-entry permission must cover the journey.

targetPassages.text: Prestanak osnova boravka može zahtevati postupanje pre datuma odštampanog na ARC-u. Član 31 Zakona o ulasku, izlasku i imigraciji nalaže Nacionalnoj imigracionoj agenciji, NIA, da ukine odobrenje boravka i poništi karticu kada razlog boravka prestane. Zakon istovremeno propisuje slučajeve u kojima NIA može odobriti nastavak boravka.

Dokument o promeni pokazuje od kog događaja se računa rok. To može biti obaveštenje o prestanku zaposlenja, diploma, isprava o porodičnom statusu ili ugovor za novu adresu. Spisak NIA traži dokaze koji odgovaraju produženju ili promeni za koju se podnosi zahtev.
Događaj ili zahtev
Kada i kome se podnosi
Uobičajeno produženje ARC-a
NIA-i tokom tri meseca pre isteka postojećeg boravka, najkasnije pre njegovog isteka.
Promena adrese stanovanja ili mesta rada
Zahtev NIA-i za registraciju promene u roku od 30 dana od narednog dana po promeni.
Promena osnova obuhvaćena članom 23-1 Zakona o imigraciji
Zahtev NIA-i u roku od 30 dana od datuma događaja.
Promena osnova van slučajeva iz člana 23-1
Zahtev za novu boravišnu vizu BOCA-i ili njenoj područnoj službi u roku od 15 dana od događaja; zatim postupak pred NIA.

Registraciju adrese i mesta rada uređuje član 31. Za promenu razloga boravka i produženje merodavni su članovi 7 i 9 propisa o boravku stranaca. Rok BOCA od 15 dana odnosi se na podnošenje zahteva za vizu. Ne znači da viza do tada mora biti izdata.

Preduzetnik koji nastavlja poslovanje na Tajvanu i ispunjava uslove može podneti zahtev za produženje tokom četiri meseca pre isteka. Kada taj posao prestane, poseban put nastavka boravka ima period za prijavu tokom tri meseca pre isteka. Obnova Gold Card-a takođe se otvara četiri meseca pre isteka kartice.

U opštem postupku produženja NIA traži obrazac, pasoš, postojeći ARC, fotografiju i aktuelni dokaz osnova boravka. Dokument može poticati od poslodavca ili obrazovne ustanove, odnosno potvrđivati porodični odnos. Posle selidbe prilaže se i dokaz nove adrese.

Dokazi treba da pokrivaju traženi period. Kod rada to uključuje odgovarajuću dozvolu, a kod studiranja dokumentaciju o upisanom periodu. Ranije pribavljanje tih isprava ostavlja vreme da se reši dozvola koja uskoro ističe ili nepotpun dokaz upisa.

Učenje mandarinskog ima posebna ograničenja. Prema studentskom uputstvu NIA, pojedinačno produženje prati dokazani period učenja i može trajati najviše šest meseci. Zbir kratkotrajnog boravka i boravka sa ARC-om po ovom osnovu načelno je ograničen na dve godine. To nije opšta granica svih studijskih programa.

Član 3 pravila o taksama određuje 1.000 novih tajvanskih dolara za svaku odobrenu godinu produženja; i kraći period naplaćuje se kao jedna godina. Kategorija i odluka NIA određuju trajanje. Uplata ga ne produžava sama.

Šta ako je rok već istekao? Član 31 stav 3 dopušta novu prijavu posle izrečene kazne ako prekoračenje traje manje od 30 dana i prvobitni razlog boravka i dalje postoji. Zadržava se i zakonsko odbijanje jedne godine pri računanju perioda za stalni boravak. Ova mogućnost ne pomera raniji datum isteka; o nastaloj situaciji treba odmah obavestiti NIA.

Posle selidbe podnosi se zahtev za registraciju uz dokaz nove adrese u navedenom roku od 30 dana. Promena adrese u evidenciji banke ili univerziteta ne zamenjuje zahtev NIA-i po članu 31. Sačuvajte potvrdu podnošenja.

Promena poslodavca ili dodatni posao podležu članu 53 Zakona o službama zapošljavanja, uz uslove određene radnom kategorijom. Pre početka novog rada mora postojati odgovarajuća dozvola ili oslobođenje. Upis mesta rada kod NIA ne daje tu dozvolu.

Prestanak starog posla, odobrenje novog rada i selidba mogu imati različite datume. Uz svaki se čuva njegova isprava. Tako se može utvrditi koji događaj pokreće prijavu i da li treba menjati i osnov boravka.
Član 23-1 Zakona o imigraciji dopušta prijavu za promenu osnova samo u navedenim situacijama. Preostali meseci na kartici sami ne potvrđuju da je novi osnov prihvatljiv.

Mogućnost nastavka po članu 31 obuhvata i određene slučajeve smrti člana porodice na kojem se boravak zasnivao, dece na Tajvanu, sudskog radnog spora koji je u toku ili povrede na radu čije lečenje traje. NIA može odobriti nastavak kada su uslovi konkretnog osnova ispunjeni.

Kod izuzetka za razvod zbog nasilja u porodici, strani podnosilac mora biti razveden zbog tog nasilja i ne sme ponovo sklopiti brak. Bivši tajvanski supružnik mora pripadati kategoriji državljana koji žive na Tajvanu i imaju registraciju domaćinstva. Osnovi povezani sa brigom o detetu, roditeljskim pravima ili viđanjem deteta odnose se na propisane situacije sa maloletnim detetom sa registracijom domaćinstva na Tajvanu. Sam razvod zato ne daje automatsko pravo ostanka niti u svakom slučaju nalaže odlazak.

Kvalifikovani stručnjaci i određeni članovi porodice sa odobrenim boravkom mogu pre isteka zatražiti produženje po članu 17 Zakona o stranim stručnjacima. Kada je odobreno, traje šest meseci od narednog dana po isteku ranijeg ARC-a ili Gold Card-a. Pre isteka tog produženja može se tražiti još jedno. Ukupan maksimum je godinu dana. To je drugi postupak od obnove samog Gold Card-a i ne produžava automatski raniju radnu dozvolu.

Za diplomce koji ispunjavaju uslove člana 11 propisa o boravku, zahtev se takođe podnosi pre isteka. Po odobrenju, produženje traje godinu dana od narednog dana po isteku prethodnog boravka. Ako je potrebno, može se tražiti još jedno, do ukupno dve godine. Završetak običnog jezičkog kursa ne daje isti status.

Posebno oslobođenje od radne dozvole iz člana 12 Zakona o stranim stručnjacima važi za stranca koji je na Tajvanu stekao najmanje stepen associate degree i kome je NIA, u statusu novodiplomiranog studenta, zakonito odobrila produženje boravka. Oslobođenje traje tokom tog odobrenog perioda. Diploma sama nije dovoljna.

Početni upit o radnom ili porodičnom sporu koji utiče na boravak pošaljite na wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw, uz događaj i relevantne datume, bez broja pasoša i originalnih identifikacionih isprava. Konsultacije se vode na engleskom, kineskom, japanskom ili korejskom.

Posle izdavanja novog pasoša moraju se ažurirati podaci kod NIA, prema njenom uputstvu o promeni pasoša. Spisak za promenu podataka obuhvata obrazac, fotografiju, pasoš i dokaz promene. Stari pasoš ili njegova kopija povezuje prethodni i novi zapis. Rok za promenu adrese ne treba prenositi na svaku promenu pasoša.

Za izgubljenu ili oštećenu karticu, uz odgovarajući zahtev i identifikacione dokumente prilažu se oštećeni ARC, izjava o gubitku, policijska potvrda ili drugi dokaz primeren događaju. Standardna taksa za zamenu je 500 novih tajvanskih dolara, prema članu 7 pravila o taksama. Zamena ne produžava boravak.

Ako kartica nestane u inostranstvu, pre povratka se obratite NIA i nadležnom tajvanskom predstavništvu. Pripremite podatke pasoša, kopiju ARC-a ako je imate i datum planiranog povratka. Potreban dokument zavisi od tog slučaja; mogućnost zamene kartice nije garancija ukrcavanja ili ulaska.

Dozvola za ponovni ulazak mora biti pribavljena pre odlaska, prema članu 34 Zakona o imigraciji. Za osobu sa odobrenim stalnim boravkom postoji izuzetak: može se vratiti uz važeći pasoš i APRC. Kod redovne dozvole, član 20 propisa o boravku vezuje njeno važenje za ARC i predviđa prestanak kada se kartica poništi.

Poseban efekat odlaska propisan je za onlajn postupak stručnjaka i njihovih porodica, napomena 9. Ako podnosilac napusti Tajvan dok traje obrada, NIA obustavlja razmatranje te prijave. Posle ponovnog ulaska može podneti novu ako ispunjava uslove za odgovarajuću kategoriju. Ovo pravilo uređuje navedeni portal, a ne opštu zabranu putovanja svakog nosioca ARC-a.

Potvrda prijave i fotografija kartice ne zamenjuju potrebne putne dokumente. Kada obnova ili zamena neće biti završena do odlaska, od NIA treba dobiti uputstvo za stvarni datum povratka. Za nosioca važećeg ARC-a ili APRC-a NIA objašnjava da pasoš mora važiti na dan dolaska, bez opšteg zahteva za još šest meseci važenja u toj situaciji. Provera pri ulasku i ostali primenljivi uslovi ostaju.

Prvu karticu obrađuje vodič za prvi ARC, a izbor novog osnova pregled rada, studija i porodice. Stalni boravak i APRC, na engleskom, imaju zasebne uslove. Za predstojeći put presudni su dokumenti koje ćete zaista imati i njihov rok važenja na dan povratka.

| Change of residence address or place of employment | Within 30 days counted from the day after the change. |
| Change of residence reason qualifying under Immigration Act Article 23-1 | Application to NIA within 30 days from the event date. |
| Change of residence reason outside Article 23-1 | The residence regulations prescribe a new resident-visa application to BOCA within 15 days from the event, followed by the NIA residence application. |

[Immigration Act Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) governs address and workplace registration; [Articles 7 and 9 of the residence regulations](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129) govern changes of residence reason and extensions. Address changes are counted from the following day, while the regulations count a change of residence reason from the event date.

Some programs allow an earlier renewal application. A qualifying [entrepreneur ARC extension for a continuing Taiwan business](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/348924/) can be filed during the four months before expiry. The separate continued-residence route after that business ceases has a three-month advance window. [Gold Card renewal](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/406403/) opens four months before expiry.

## Renewal while the job, course or family basis continues

An ordinary extension requires the form, passport, existing ARC, photograph and current evidence of the reason for residence. [NIA's guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) calls for employment, study or family documents as appropriate, plus new address evidence if you have moved.

The supporting documents need to cover the requested period. An employment-based extension depends on the relevant employment permission, while a student's enrollment records support the study period sought. Obtaining those records in advance leaves time to address an expiring work approval or incomplete enrollment evidence before the ARC application is due.

Mandarin-study extensions are more limited. Under the [NIA student guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), each extension follows the enrollment evidence and is capped at six months. The combined stay and residence period is generally limited to two years.

Standard extension fees are NT$1,000 per year of approved validity; a shorter period is charged as one year under [Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135). The residence category determines the period NIA may approve. Paying for a longer period does not create an entitlement to it.

Already past expiry? Contact NIA immediately. [Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) allows a limited reapplication after a penalty when the overstay is less than 30 days and the original residence reason continues. That provision leaves the original expiry date unchanged; it is not an ordinary grace period.

## A move or a new employer

A move requires new address evidence and NIA registration within the 30-day period. Updating a bank, university or employer's records does not complete the immigration registration required by [Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31). Keep the dated submission record.

For a new employer or an additional job, [Employment Service Act Article 53](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) sets requirements that differ by worker category. The new work must be covered by the applicable permit or exemption before it begins. An NIA address or workplace update does not itself authorize that employment.

## When the original reason for residence ends

After graduation, termination of employment or a family-status change, an ARC holder may apply for a new residence basis under [Immigration Act Article 23-1](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23-1) only in the situations that provision lists.

Continued residence may also be available under [Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31), including specified circumstances involving a deceased family sponsor, domestic violence, children in Taiwan, labor litigation or an occupational injury. Each ground has its own conditions, so a divorce or employment dispute alone does not establish either a right to remain or an inevitable obligation to leave.

Qualifying professionals can seek the extension in [Foreign Professionals Act Article 17](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295). If approved, it runs for six months from the day after the original ARC or Gold Card expires. One further extension is available, up to a total of one year. Apply before expiry. Graduates have a different extension framework under [Article 11 of the residence regulations](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129), with eligibility tied to the completed program; the professional timetable does not apply to every student.

An initial email to Hovering International Law Firm at [wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw](mailto:wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw) about an employment or family dispute affecting residence should state the event and relevant dates. Leave passport numbers and original identity documents out of that message.

## Passport updates and replacement cards

A renewed passport requires a corresponding update to NIA's records, as its [passport-renewal FAQ](https://news.immigration.gov.tw/EasyPack/Detail/DDA469F4-E2D0-4A98-847C-21432DCC040E?lang=EN) explains. For a data change, [NIA's checklist](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) requires the application, photograph, passport and evidence of the change. Keeping the old passport or a copy helps connect the old and new records.

NIA's guide lists the damaged card, a loss declaration, a police report or other evidence as appropriate when an ARC is lost or damaged. [Article 7 of the fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) sets the standard replacement fee at NT$500. Replacing the card does not extend residence.

Loss abroad also affects the return journey. Before attempting to travel back, contact NIA and the relevant [Taiwan overseas mission](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) with your passport details, an ARC copy if available, and intended return date. They can identify which document your circumstances require.

## Travel before the new card arrives

Re-entry requires valid permission under [Immigration Act Article 34](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=34). [Article 20 of the residence regulations](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129) ties that permission to the ARC's validity period and cancels it when the ARC is canceled. The permission recorded with the card therefore needs to cover the intended return date, along with the passport and residence status.

Before departing while a renewal or replacement is pending, obtain NIA's instructions for the actual journey. An application receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents, particularly when the new card will not be ready before you leave.

Initial applications are covered in [first ARC steps](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application); a new residence purpose is covered in the [work, study and family comparison](/en/columns/taiwan-visa-residence-work-study-family). Permanent residence has its own requirements, addressed in [APRC applications](/en/columns/taiwan-permanent-residence-aprc). For an upcoming trip, the immediate issue remains whether the documents you will carry cover the date you plan to return.

Legal sources checked October 24, 2026. This guide describes foreign-national procedures and category-specific exceptions, without determining an individual case. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.
